title: citrus medica subf. kizu
intro: Citrus medica subf. kizu, commonly known as Fingered citron or Buddha's hand, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family and is a variant of the citron fruit. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including aiding in digestion, reducing inflammation, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of the Fingered citron include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its traditional use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Citrus medica subf. kizu include limonoids, flavonoids, and other compounds that have been shown to have various pharmacological activities, including anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory effects.
